# Code map (generated by tools/build_code_graph.py; do not edit by hand)

Read this instead of opening the scripts. Open a file only at the lines you need. To ask the graph a
question (needs `pip install graphifyy`): `graphify query "what writes cues.js?" --graph
references/code-graph/graph.json`, or `graphify explain "render"`, or `graphify path "mix" "render"`.

## Services (scripts/services.json)

make_film.py runs these in order. Each one is one script that talks to the others only through files in the
film folder. A service is skipped when its outputs are newer than its inputs and its command is unchanged.
Run one alone with `make_film.py <film> --only <service>`; see the plan with `--dry-run`.

| Service | Script | Reads | Writes | Needs | If it fails |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| voice-cache | built in | vo-{voice_id}/* | vo/*.json | - | stop |
| voice-elevenlabs | tts_elevenlabs.js | narration.json | vo/*.wav, vo/*.json | node, ffmpeg, env:ELEVENLABS_API_KEY | stop |
| voice-sapi | tts_sapi.ps1 | narration.json | vo/*.wav, vo/*.json | powershell.exe, ffmpeg | stop |
| voice-import | import_voice.py | narration.json, {voice_src}/* | vo/*.wav, vo/*.json | ffmpeg | stop |
| align | align_whisper.py | narration.json, vo/*.wav, vo/*.json | vo/*.json | ffmpeg, python:faster_whisper | warn |
| timeline | build_timeline.js | narration.json, vo/*.wav, vo/*.json | cues.js, vo-track.wav | node, ffmpeg | stop |
| score | score.js | score.js, cues.js?, beats.js?, {engine}/audio-lib.js | music.wav | node | stop |
| score-accents | score.js | score.js, cues.js?, beats.js?, {engine}/audio-lib.js | accents.wav | node | stop |
| music-file | music_file.py | {music_src}, cues.js?, beats.js? | bed.wav | ffmpeg | stop |
| mix | mix.js | music.wav, vo-track.wav?, bed.wav?, accents.wav? | mix.wav | node, ffmpeg | stop |
| render | render.js | index.html, *.js, brand/*?, mix.wav, {engine}/motion.js, {engine}/render.js | {video} | node, ffmpeg, chrome, node:puppeteer-core | stop |
| captions | make_captions.js | cues.js | {srt} | node | stop |
| attach-captions | attach_captions.py | {video}, {srt} | {out} | ffmpeg | stop |
| intro | built in | intro/narration.json?, intro/beats.js?, intro/*.js | intro/intro.mp4 | - | stop |
| outro | built in | outro/narration.json?, outro/beats.js?, outro/*.js | outro/outro.mp4 | - | stop |
| bookends | bookends.py | {video}, {srt}?, intro/intro.mp4?, intro/intro.srt?, outro/outro.mp4?, outro/outro.srt?, bookends/*? | {out}, build/bookends.json | ffmpeg | stop |
| deliver | built in | {video} | {out} | - | stop |
| check | check_film.py | {out} | - | ffmpeg | warn |

Pipelines: **narrated**: voice-* -> align -> timeline -> score -> mix -> render -> captions -> attach-captions -> check; **silent**: score -> mix -> render -> deliver -> check; **_variants**: m -> a -> k -> e -> _ -> f -> i -> l -> m -> . -> p -> y ->   -> a -> d -> j -> u -> s -> t -> s ->   -> a ->   -> p -> i -> p -> e -> l -> i -> n -> e -> : ->   -> - -> - -> m -> u -> s -> i -> c ->   -> F -> I -> L -> E ->   -> a -> d -> d -> s ->   -> s -> c -> o -> r -> e -> - -> a -> c -> c -> e -> n -> t -> s ->   -> a -> n -> d ->   -> m -> u -> s -> i -> c -> - -> f -> i -> l -> e ->   -> b -> e -> f -> o -> r -> e ->   -> m -> i -> x -> ; ->   -> b -> o -> o -> k -> e -> n -> d -> s ->   -> ( -> a -> n ->   -> i -> n -> t -> r -> o ->   -> o -> r ->   -> o -> u -> t -> r -> o ->   -> f -> o -> l -> d -> e -> r -> , ->   -> o -> r ->   -> c -> l -> i -> p -> s ->   -> i -> n ->   -> b -> o -> o -> k -> e -> n -> d -> s -> / -> ) ->   -> r -> e -> p -> l -> a -> c -> e ->   -> a -> t -> t -> a -> c -> h -> - -> c -> a -> p -> t -> i -> o -> n -> s ->   -> o -> r ->   -> d -> e -> l -> i -> v -> e -> r ->   -> w -> i -> t -> h ->   -> i -> n -> t -> r -> o -> , ->   -> o -> u -> t -> r -> o -> , ->   -> b -> o -> o -> k -> e -> n -> d -> s -> ; ->   -> - -> - -> c -> a -> p -> t -> i -> o -> n -> s ->   -> n -> o -> n -> e ->   -> d -> r -> o -> p -> s ->   -> c -> a -> p -> t -> i -> o -> n -> s ->   -> a -> n -> d ->   -> a -> t -> t -> a -> c -> h -> - -> c -> a -> p -> t -> i -> o -> n -> s -> ..

Paths: {film} is the film folder; {engine} is <project>/engine (a copy of scripts/); {build} is {film}/build
(intermediate video and stamps.json); {video} is build/<film>.mp4; {out} is the delivered <film>.mp4; {srt} sits
next to it.

## Add or change a service

1. Write the script so it reads and writes files only (no imports from other services), with its usage in
   its first lines.
2. Add it to scripts/services.json: run, in, out, needs, on_fail (and always: true only for cheap, idempotent
   steps). Put it in a pipeline.
3. Run `python tools/build_code_graph.py` so this map and the graph follow.
